title: CrossNox · historical asymmetric-geometry refinement
description: Historical parameter refinement of OpenAI’s seven-eighths proof to 4374785349/5000000000 = 0.8749570698 for all Dirichlet L-functions, excluding the principal pole. The original development also covers zeta and finite-order Eisenstein Hecke L-functions. A larger slot mass and asymmetric physical lengths are carried through low and high estimates, source moments, Euler corrections and continuation. Source imported from CrossNox/quasi-riemann-hypothesis-extension at 3dddb77a62182f8d530c368ed5e9220079fbd1b9; the upstream README states that the paper, Lean proofs and scripts were entirely AI-generated. This tracker adaptation relocates module imports, renames one local pool helper to avoid a duplicate baseline declaration, and adds the canonical entrypoint, preserving the proof logic and attribution to OpenAI/math. The published numerical refinement is historical; this PR does not claim a new frontier or a completed tracker verification. Public announcement is dated by the first source-history commit carrying this exact bound: f677cc0a820bb2aff86bb4cbe783d076f5c097db, committed at 2026-10-08T23:33:38Z (author and committer timestamps agree). This records the source commit time, not a separately observed public push time. The historical directory retains the same UTC calendar date.
